help.title: Keyboard & mouse
help.text:
C Column / R NULL row / Enter or F2 Edit
Ctrl+Delete / Delete: confirm clearing cell
Alt/Shift+Enter Newline / ^U Clear editor
^S Save / ^Q Quit (Y Save, N Discard)
^Z Undo / ^C Copy cell / ^V Paste cell
Arrows Move / PgUp, PgDn Row page
Tab / Shift+Tab: next / previous col page
Home / End: first / last col; ^ also row
F6 Cell/Row/Column / Shift+Space Row
Ctrl+Space Column / Esc Cell selection
[ / ] Row count / - / + Column count
Ctrl+, / F4 Settings (language, page size)
Mouse: cells, headers, footer controls
F1 / Enter / Esc Close (^ means Ctrl)
status.initial: C: add column  R: add row  Enter: edit  Ctrl+,: settings  F1: help
status.cell_cleared: Cell content deleted (NULL); Ctrl+Z restores it
status.column_added: Column added; R adds a row

cli.help:
Parquet Studio — a typed dataset editor

Usage: parquet-editor [FILE.parquet]

An existing file is opened; a new path starts an empty dataset.
Without a path, Ctrl+S asks where to save.

C: column  R: row  Enter: edit  Ctrl+S: save  Ctrl+Q: quit
Ctrl+Delete: delete cell content  Ctrl+,: settings  F1: help
